chunks: They rejected each one of Our signs. So We seized them with the grip of one mighty and powerful.
ai.seo_question: What is the consequence of rejecting all of God's signs according to this verse?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Al-Qamar, this verse serves as a concluding warning to the disbelievers of Mecca, emphasizing that their total rejection of divine signs ('kullaha') invites a decisive and inescapable seizure. Shia exegetes often highlight the attributes 'Aziz' (Mighty) and 'Muqtadir' (All-Powerful) to illustrate that God's punishment is not merely forceful but executed with absolute sovereignty and capability, leaving no room for escape.
